claim_under_attack.text: The coordinated C=N amine-rule fix withstands independent adversarial verification in this module.

does_not_close: EVALUATION_SIGNATURE_ABSENT (this is an AUDIT_ONLY science-validation replay, not a Phase-0 evaluation/review signature).
Whether reactive_amine_hydrogen_count should be exactly 0 for guanidine N-H in a quantitative AHEW sense (mechanistic nucleophilicity question, out of scope, explicitly left open by R-N02 itself).
The molecule-property side of R-N02 (compute_amine_class.py) and the molecule-role-ranker side (DPG/DOTG fixture v1/v2); those are the separate V-N02a and V-N02b verify scopes, not re-attacked here.

method: (a) Re-ran `cargo test -p amphora-rdkit-ffi --features rdkit` fresh against the pinned RDKit 2026.03.2 toolchain prefix (/home/ubuntu/.local/share/amphora/rdkit-2026.03.2), independently of R-N02's own recorded test run. (b) Read amphora-rdkit-ffi/src/bridge.cc directly (sha256 below) and confirmed is_amidine_or_guanidine_carbon (lines defining the C=N neighbor check) is structurally identical in form to is_carbonyl_carbon (same atomicNum==6 guard, same single-bond-iteration-for-a-DOUBLE-bond-to-a-given-atomic-number pattern, differing only in the target atomic number: {8,16} for carbonyl/thiocarbonyl vs {7} for amidine/guanidine), and is OR'd into the exact same per-neighbor exclusion disjunction already used by is_carbonyl_carbon and is_sulfonyl_sulfur -- a minimal, symmetric diff. (c) Grepped the entire repository (excluding target/) for the three symbol names implicated in the coordinated fix and cross-checked every hit against R-N02's own consumer_sweep table; any hit not named there was checked for whether it postdates R-N02 (a later verify/repair fire's own work product) or is itself a signing/meta script, not a rule consumer. (d) Authored a fresh, independent Rust binary crate (vn02c-verify, path-dependency on amphora-rdkit-ffi with feature=rdkit -- the REAL production FFI) that re-derives reactive_amine_hydrogen_count via molecule_facts() for: the 5 guanidine-family probes from R-N02's own five_probe_summary; a real coating-relevant cycloaliphatic diamine hardener (IPDA, CAS 2855-13-2) as an over-exclusion regression sanity check (no C=N present -- the fix must not collaterally zero ordinary hardeners); agmatine (CAS 306-60-5), an adversarial probe carrying a real primary amine structurally REMOTE from an incidental guanidine group, designed to catch a too-broad whole-molecule (rather than correctly-scoped per-neighbor-carbon) exclusion bug; and a protonated guanidinium cation sanity check. Two additional out-of-scope behaviors (a ketimine self-exclusion side effect and a vinylogous-enaminone conjugation blind spot pre-existing and identical in kind for the O/S rule) were surfaced and are disclosed as informational, non-refuting findings -- neither is a claim R-N02 makes or a defect specific to the C=N fix.
objective: INDEPENDENT VERIFY of interactive repair R-N02 on the amphora-rdkit-ffi side (the production C++ FFI itself: bridge.cc::count_reactive_amine_hydrogens). This receipt's author did not write R-N02. Attacked claims: (1) cargo test for amphora-rdkit-ffi --features rdkit is green, including the R-N02 regression test; (2) the new is_amidine_or_guanidine_carbon exclusion is structurally symmetric in form with the pre-existing is_carbonyl_carbon / is_sulfonyl_sulfur neighbor-exclusion predicates and was added as a minimal diff to the same disjunction; (3) every consumer of reactive_amine_hydrogen_count / count_reactive_amine_hydrogens in the repository either links the fixed crate or was explicitly dispositioned in R-N02's own consumer_sweep.
pre_registered_refute_criterion: CLAIM_REFUTED if ANY of: cargo test for amphora-rdkit-ffi --features rdkit fails, or the pinned_native_backend_excludes_guanidine_class_amine_hydrogens regression test is absent or failing; is_amidine_or_guanidine_carbon is not structurally symmetric in form with is_carbonyl_carbon (e.g. different bond-iteration pattern, or not OR'd into the same neighbor-exclusion disjunction); any of the 5 guanidine-family probes (DPG, DOTG, guanidine, dicyandiamide, biguanide) fails to reproduce reactive_amine_hydrogen_count==0 via the real FFI; the IPDA over-exclusion-regression sanity probe deviates from its structurally-expected count of 4 (would indicate collateral damage to ordinary hardeners); the agmatine adversarial probe deviates from its structurally-expected count of 2 (would indicate a too-broad, whole-molecule exclusion bug); the protonated-guanidinium sanity probe yields nonzero count; OR any consumer of the symbol found by a fresh repo-wide grep is neither named in R-N02's own consumer_sweep nor identifiable as a later fire's own work product / meta signing script (an undisclosed orphan).

informational_disclosures.note: Primary ketimine >C=N-H: the new rule's neighbor-carbon check fires on the imine's OWN double bond partner (the candidate N itself), so this non-amine imine N-H is now excluded post-fix (was miscounted as 1 pre-fix). This is a positive collateral correctness effect of structural symmetry with is_carbonyl_carbon, not a claim made or tested by R-N02; disclosed as informational only.

Push-pull enaminone (vinylogous amide): the amine nitrogen's direct neighbor is a vinyl carbon double-bonded to carbon (not O/S/N), so NEITHER the pre-existing carbonyl rule NOR the new C=N rule excludes it, despite real resonance delocalization through the vinyl bridge. This local-neighbor-only design limitation is IDENTICAL in kind and pre-existing for the O/S rule (equally misses vinylogous amides); it is not introduced by, or specific to, the R-N02 C=N fix and is therefore not a valid falsifier of R-N02's claim. Disclosed as an out-of-scope residual gap.

why: Every pre-registered refute trigger was checked and none fired. cargo test is green including R-N02's own regression test, re-run independently. Direct source inspection confirms is_amidine_or_guanidine_carbon is structurally symmetric with is_carbonyl_carbon (same pattern, target atomic number 7 vs {8,16}) and is added to the same neighbor-exclusion disjunction as a minimal diff. A fresh repo-wide grep sweep for the implicated symbols found 38 hits; every one is either named in R-N02's own consumer_sweep or is a later fire's own work product / signing script (not an undisclosed orphan reimplementation that missed the fix). All 5 of R-N02's own guanidine-family probes re-derive reactive_amine_hydrogen_count=0 through a freshly authored harness calling the real production FFI. Two adversarial over-exclusion regression probes -- a real cycloaliphatic hardener (IPDA) and a remote-amine-plus-incidental-guanidine molecule (agmatine) -- both retain their structurally correct, nonzero counts, directly evidencing the fix's exclusion is scoped per-neighbor-carbon and does not collaterally over-exclude ordinary or structurally-adjacent-but-distinct amine N-H. Two out-of-scope behaviors were disclosed (ketimine self-exclusion; vinylogous-enaminone blind spot) but neither is a claim R-N02 makes or a defect introduced by, or specific to, the C=N fix under test.
